Chapter 7103: I Have A Badass Dad

Chapter 7103: I Have A Badass Dad

Li Qiye left the new world and returned to Duality Enterprise.

“Why are you shouting for me?” Li Qiye frowned.

“Old man, don’t be so egotistic, I didn’t call for you.” The baldy jumped up and glanced at him with disdain.

“No?” Li Qiye stared at him.

“Not my problem, someone else is looking for you.” He angrily said.

“Definitely not anything good since it came from you.” Li Qiye said.

“It’s not like I would come looking for you, I’m already the heaven’s favorite son, unique in history...” He raised his hands.

Li Qiye smacked his shiny head and said: “Heaven’s favorite son? You’re itching for a beating?”

“Can you not be so uncultured? It’s a metaphor, ever heard of it? Probably never read a book before.” He said indignantly.

“Right, I was just a shepherd. Have you seen an educated shepherd before?” Li Qiye joked.

“You are discriminating against shepherds then, don’t drag them all down just because you’re uncultured, they have nothing to do with you.” He said.

“Right, only you have something to do with me, and you require education.” Li Qiye rubbed his palms.

“Such rotten luck, can’t you talk some sense instead of always relying on force?”

“You got that right, I don’t bother with reason, especially not when disciplining my son.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Bah.” He pointed at Li Qiye and cursed: “I don’t owe you anything, I’m not going to let you do this! I’m cultured, refined, and well-mannered, and I would never hit children, something you haven’t learned. Don’t you know you should feel guilty?”

“Why should I?” Li Qiye asked.

“Because education comes from the parents, but you haven’t taught me anything...” He glared at Li Qiye.

“The heaven and earth can educate, and since I’m heaven and earth, I’ve educated.” Li Qiye said.

“Bah, that’s nonsense and shameless. It’s all due to my invincible dao heart.” He said with disdain.

“I do not deny your dao heart.” Li Qiye said: “But you wouldn’t have been able to make it this far and so fast without the world’s enlightenment.”

“Either way, it has nothing to do with you. If I were born in the same era as you, I would have easily surpassed you.” He claimed.

“Surpassed me?” Li Qiye chuckled and slapped his head again: “You still have a long way to go.”

“As if you are the only one who can make it this far.” He arched his chest and said: “I’m destined to surpass you since you are old now.”

“Are you sure?” Li Qiye smirked.

“Old man, I won’t fall to your trickery again...” His confidence wavered.

“Remember, if you make a claim, be sure to carry it out. Otherwise, it’ll be a beating...” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, don’t misunderstand, I was talking about how you’re old and don’t look as good as me anymore. Of course, you never stood a chance even when you were young, just so ordinary while I’m known throughout this world for being good-looking.” He said.

Li Qiye slapped his head again and said: “At least surpass me in something worthwhile.”

“Old man, I just know how to be humble, we’re all mortals and should not be enslaved by vanity. Look at you, after getting a little success, you’re going around bragging and causing trouble as if wanting to announce your power...” He retorted.

“Has it been too long since your last proper beating?” Li Qiye slapped him and laughed.

“Haha, forget it, I can’t hit a lonely old man, I won’t entertain you.” He said.

“No ambition or courage at all.” Li Qiye said.

“I just need my looks and I can go anywhere in Heavenrealm or the other worlds.” He said: “It’s okay, I sympathize, you’ve been ugly forever so you needed to work hard. Just don’t be jealous of me, we’re either born handsome or not.”

“Is that all?” Li Qiye said.

“Of course not, outside of becoming handsome, I also have a badass dad. Do you?” He asked.

“No, and enough of this lip service.” Li Qiye patted his head gently this time.
